warnings.warning_zh: MSKCC話，如果你食緊降膽固醇藥，就唔好食紅麴。歐盟法例規定紅麴產品要警告食緊降膽固醇藥嘅人唔好用。紅麴含有一種同他汀藥洛伐他汀完全一樣嘅成分。
warnings.action_en: If you take this medicine and want to use this herb, talk to your doctor or pharmacist first. Tell them about every herb and supplement you use. Tell your doctor straight away if you get unexplained muscle pain or weakness.
warnings.action_zh: 如果你食緊呢類藥，又想用呢種藥材，請先話俾醫生或者藥劑師知。記得講埋你用緊嘅所有藥材同補充品。 如果無啦啦肌肉痛或者無力，要即刻話俾醫生知。
warnings.notes: Already live. European Commission is a regulator but not named in the owner's example list; checker/owner to accept or drop. The muscle-pain line in action_en is not stated by these sources for red yeast rice specifically (HA lists muscle pain as a side effect); checker may remove it. MSKCC page snippet index age ~3.7 years.
